## What's fixed

- **Music started from the widget keeps playing.** Tapping play on the widget without opening Kultr starts it in the background, and iOS keeps a background app running only while it is making sound. Between two songs — while the next one loads, or a stream catches up — there can be a moment of silence, and iOS could put Kultr to sleep right then, so the music stopped after a few songs until you tapped play again. Kultr now asks iOS for time to bridge those moments, so the next song always gets to start.
- **The next song is always lined up in time.** InjeKt waits for both songs to be analysed before it plans a blend. In the background iOS slows that work down, and a plan could still be missing when a song ended, so the next one only started loading then — in silence. Both songs are now analysed side by side, the wait is cut short when the song is running out, and fifteen seconds before the end Kultr goes ahead with a plain crossfade if the plan still isn't ready.
- **Less going on in the background.** Started from the widget, Kultr now leaves the library check and any waiting downloads until you open it, and analyses only the next song ahead, so the music has the phone and the connection to itself.
- A late notice from iOS that Kultr had been asleep no longer pauses what is playing.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
